info.title: VoiceML — Twilio-compatible REST API
info.summary: Twilio-compatible voice (inbound + outbound), SMS, conferencing, recording, transcription, and payment platform
info.description:
VoiceML exposes a Twilio-compatible REST + TwiML surface covering
voice (inbound + outbound calls, conferences, queues), SMS via the
Messages resource, mid-call recording / SIPREC / real-time
transcription / `<Pay>` subresources, and the `IncomingPhoneNumbers`
+ `Applications` configuration surfaces. Existing Twilio SDKs
(`twilio-node`, `twilio-python`, `twilio-go`, ...) integrate with
minimal migration effort. Authentication, error codes, and
pagination follow Twilio's documented conventions where supported.

URL format: Twilio's canonical URL form ends with `.json` (e.g.
`/Calls/{Sid}.json`). VoiceML accepts BOTH the `.json`-suffixed and
the unsuffixed form — the server strips a trailing `.json`/`.xml`/`.wav`
suffix before routing. The spec documents the
`.json` form so SDKs generated against this spec produce
Twilio-compatible URLs out of the box; existing clients that omit `.json`
continue to work unchanged.

Authentication is per-tenant HTTP Basic:
  * Username = `:AccountSid` (the URL path parameter, Twilio-format
    AC + 32 hex chars). Same value the Twilio SDK validates in its
    constructor — migration-compatible.
  * Password = the per-account API key.
The same key is used to compute `X-Twilio-Signature` on outbound webhooks.

Self-serve key rotation is exposed: `POST /RotateKey` on the
authenticated account rotates the caller's own API key. Wider account
administration (create / disable / delete) is not part of the public
API.

servers.description: VoiceML base API host. Fetch /openapi.json, /openapi.yaml, or /openapi.yml for a document whose server URLs target the answering instance. Conversations and Messaging resources declare their product servers separately. Public defaults are https://voiceml.voicetel.com, https://conversations.voicetel.com, and https://messaging.voicetel.com.

The Call resource and its non-recording subresources

Async / post-recording transcription resource — list/fetch/delete
under `/Transcriptions` (account-scoped) and
`/Recordings/{RecordingSid}/Transcriptions` (per-recording). Rows
are created as a side effect of `<Record transcribe="true">`; this
resource is read + delete only (no create).

Recordings scoped to a parent conference — list under

The Account resource — fetch and update the authenticated account

tags.name: Api20100401Balance
tags.description: The Account Balance resource — fetch the account's current balance.

tags.name: Api20100401OutgoingCallerId
tags.description:
The OutgoingCallerId resource — list/fetch/update/delete verified
outbound caller IDs; POST on the collection starts a
ValidationRequest (caller-ID verification).

tags.name: Api20100401ValidationRequest

The ValidationRequest resource — POST /OutgoingCallerIds.json begins

tags.name: Api20100401SipDomain
tags.description:
The SIP Domain resource — create/list/fetch/update/delete under
`/SIP/Domains`.

tags.name: Api20100401SipCredentialList
tags.description:
The SIP CredentialList resource — create/list/fetch/update/delete
under `/SIP/CredentialLists`.

tags.name: Api20100401SipCredential
tags.description:
SIP Credentials scoped to a parent CredentialList —
create/list/fetch/update/delete under
`/SIP/CredentialLists/{CredentialListSid}/Credentials`. The `password` is
write-only (accepted on create/update, never echoed).

tags.name: Api20100401SipIpAccessControlList
tags.description:
The SIP IpAccessControlList resource — create/list/fetch/update/
delete under `/SIP/IpAccessControlLists`.

tags.name: Api20100401SipIpAddress
tags.description:
SIP IpAddresses scoped to a parent IpAccessControlList —
create/list/fetch/update/delete under
`/SIP/IpAccessControlLists/{IpAccessControlListSid}/IpAddresses`.

tags.name: Api20100401SipDomainMapping
tags.description:
SIP Domain-to-list mappings — the CredentialListMapping,
IpAccessControlListMapping, and per-direction Auth/Calls +
Auth/Registrations mapping surfaces under `/SIP/Domains/{Sid}`.
create/list/fetch/delete (no update); the response echoes the
mapped list's shape.

tags.name: RoutesV2SipDomain
tags.description:
The routes/v2 SipDomain resource — Twilio's Inbound Processing
Region API. fetch/update under `/v2/SipDomains/{SipDomain}`, keyed
by the registrable domain name and authenticated from HTTP Basic
credentials (no `/Accounts/{AccountSid}` path segment). Pins which
region processes inbound calls for the domain.

tags.name: RoutesV2PhoneNumber
tags.description:
The routes/v2 PhoneNumber resource — Twilio's Inbound Processing
Region API. fetch/update under `/v2/PhoneNumbers/{PhoneNumber}`,
keyed by the E.164 phone number and authenticated from HTTP Basic
credentials (no `/Accounts/{AccountSid}` path segment). Pins which
region processes inbound calls for the number.

tags.name: Api20100401Message
tags.description:
The Message resource — create/list/fetch/update/delete. VoiceML's
SMS + MMS surface accepts Twilio-compatible requests and routes them to the
configured provider. Supplying one or more MediaUrl values makes
the message an MMS.

tags.name: Api20100401Media
tags.description:
The Media subresource of a Message — list the media items
attached to a Message, fetch a single Media instance, or delete
one. Media bytes are served from S3 (presigned) or the recorded
external source URL.

tags.name: Api20100401Record
tags.description:
Account usage aggregation — `/Usage/Records` plus the fixed-window
(Today, Yesterday, ThisMonth, LastMonth, AllTime) and split-window
(Daily, Monthly, Yearly) subresources.

tags.name: Api20100401Recording
tags.description:
Account-scoped recording catalog — list/fetch/delete + binary
`.wav` streaming.

tags.name: Api20100401Stream
tags.description:
Media-stream subresources under `/Calls/{Sid}/Streams`.

Wire protocol: `<Stream>` / `<Connect><Stream>` carry call audio
over a WebSocket to the customer's `url`. VoiceML bridges every
stream through a translation gateway so the customer receives
**Twilio's Media Streams wire protocol** by default —
`connected` / `start` / `media` / `mark` / `stop` JSON frames
carrying G.711 µ-law (base64), bidirectional — making the OpenAI
Agents SDK, Pipecat, and LiveKit Twilio adapters work unchanged.
Gating is node-level only; there is
no per-tenant opt-in. If the gateway is not active the stream
falls back to the underlying module's native framing and the
condition is logged loudly. Barge-in (`clear`) from the customer
is accepted but cannot interrupt in-flight playback on the
current media engine — a documented limitation.

tags.name: Api20100401Siprec
tags.description: SIPREC session subresources under `/Calls/{Sid}/Siprec`.

tags.name: Api20100401IncomingPhoneNumber
tags.description:
Tenant self-serve IncomingPhoneNumbers — list/create/fetch/
update/delete.

tags.name: Api20100401Payments
tags.description:
<Pay> REST companion under `/Calls/{Sid}/Payments` — start /
modify a PCI Pay session against an existing call leg without
round-tripping TwiML. Gated by per-tenant
`pay_enabled` + `stripe_secret_key`.

tags.name: VoiceV1IpRecord
tags.description:
The Voice v1 IpRecord resource — create/list/fetch/update/delete
under `/v1/IpRecords`. A standalone
allowed source IP (with optional CIDR prefix) referenced by
SourceIpMappings. No `/Accounts/{AccountSid}` segment; account
resolves from HTTP Basic auth.

tags.name: VoiceV1SourceIpMapping
tags.description:
The Voice v1 SourceIpMapping resource — create/list/fetch/update/
delete under `/v1/SourceIpMappings`. Maps an IpRecord to a SIP
Domain so inbound calls from that source IP route to the domain.

tags.name: VoiceV1ByocTrunk
tags.description:
The Voice v1 ByocTrunk resource — create/list/fetch/update/delete
under `/v1/ByocTrunks`. Manages a bring-your-own-carrier trunk
object (the management resource for the `byoc_trunk_sid` referenced
by SIP Domains and Calls).

tags.name: VoiceV1ConnectionPolicy
tags.description:
The Voice v1 ConnectionPolicy resource — create/list/fetch/update/
delete under `/v1/ConnectionPolicies`. A named container for a
prioritized set of origination Targets.

tags.name: VoiceV1ConnectionPolicyTarget
tags.description:
Voice v1 ConnectionPolicy Targets scoped to a parent
ConnectionPolicy — create/list/fetch/update/delete under
`/v1/ConnectionPolicies/{ConnectionPolicySid}/Targets`. A single
SIP URI target with priority/weight.

tags.name: VoiceV1Settings
tags.description:
The Voice v1 DialingPermissions Settings resource — fetch/update
under `/v1/Settings`. Per-account dialing-permissions inheritance
toggle.

tags.name: ConversationsV1Conversation
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 Conversation resource — create/list/fetch/
update/delete under `/v1/Conversations` on the conversations host
(the `conversations.` subdomain of the API base domain). A stateful
messaging thread. No
`/Accounts/{AccountSid}` segment; account resolves from HTTP Basic
auth.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ConversationMessage
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 Conversation Message resource — create/list/
fetch/update/delete under
`/v1/Conversations/{ConversationSid}/Messages`. A message within a
thread, carrying a monotonic `index`.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ConversationParticipant
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 Conversation Participant resource — create/list/
fetch/update/delete under
`/v1/Conversations/{ConversationSid}/Participants`. A member of a
thread (chat identity or messaging-binding).

tags.name: ConversationsV1ConversationMessageReceipt
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 Conversation Message Receipt resource —
read-only list/fetch under
`/v1/Conversations/{ConversationSid}/Messages/{MessageSid}/Receipts`.
Per-channel delivery receipts.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ConversationScopedWebhook
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 Conversation Scoped Webhook resource —
create/list/fetch/update/delete under
`/v1/Conversations/{ConversationSid}/Webhooks`. A conversation-scoped
webhook/trigger/studio target.

tags.name: ConversationsV1Role
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 Role resource — create/list/fetch/update/delete
under `/v1/Roles`. A named permission set (conversation|service
scope).

tags.name: ConversationsV1User
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 User resource — create/list/fetch/update/delete
under `/v1/Users`. A chat identity.

tags.name: ConversationsV1Credential
ConversationsV1Configuration
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 Configuration resource — fetch/update under
`/v1/Configuration`. A per-account singleton of conversation defaults.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ConfigurationWebhook
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 Configuration Webhook resource — fetch/update
under `/v1/Configuration/Webhooks`. The account-global conversation
webhook config.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ConfigAddress
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 Configuration Address resource — create/list/
fetch/update/delete under `/v1/Configuration/Addresses`. Inbound
address auto-creation config.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ParticipantConversation
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 ParticipantConversation read-only resource — list
under `/v1/ParticipantConversations`. Finds the conversations a
participant (by Identity or Address) belongs to.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ConversationWithParticipants
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 ConversationWithParticipants resource — create
under `/v1/ConversationWithParticipants`. Creates a conversation plus
its initial participants in one call.

tags.name: ConversationsV1UserConversation
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 UserConversation resource — list/fetch/update/
delete under `/v1/Users/{Sid}/Conversations`. A user's conversation
memberships with per-user read state and notification level.

tags.name: ConversationsV1Service
tags.description:
The Conversations v1 Conversation Service resource — create/list/fetch/
delete under `/v1/Services`. A container that scopes the service-mirror
resources.

tags.name: MessagingV1Service
tags.description:
The Messaging v1 Messaging Service resource — create/list/fetch/
update/delete under `/v1/Services` on the messaging host (the
`messaging.` subdomain of the API base domain). Shares its path
shape with Conversation Service (see ConversationsV1Service) —
disambiguated by the product host the request is sent to and, on
the wire, by the sid prefix (MG vs IS). Its behavioral role is
gating scheduled messages (SendAt/ScheduleType on POST /Messages
requires a real MessagingServiceSid) — the various feature-toggle
fields (StickySender, MmsConverter, etc.) are accept-and-echo
only.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceConversation
tags.description:
The service-scoped Conversation resource — create/list/fetch/update/
delete under `/v1/Services/{ChatServiceSid}/Conversations`. Identical to
the account-level Conversation but scoped to a Conversation Service.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceConversationMessage
tags.description:
The service-scoped Conversation Message resource — create/list/fetch/
update/delete under
`/v1/Services/{ChatServiceSid}/Conversations/{ConversationSid}/Messages`.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceConversationParticipant
tags.description:
The service-scoped Conversation Participant resource — create/list/
fetch/update/delete under the service Conversation's Participants.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceConversationMessageReceipt
tags.description:
The service-scoped Conversation Message Receipt resource — read-only
list/fetch under the service Message's Receipts.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceConversationScopedWebhook
tags.description:
The service-scoped Conversation Scoped Webhook resource — create/list/
fetch/update/delete under the service Conversation's Webhooks.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceRole
tags.description:
The service-scoped Role resource — create/list/fetch/update/delete under
`/v1/Services/{ChatServiceSid}/Roles`.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceUser
tags.description:
The service-scoped User resource — create/list/fetch/update/delete under
`/v1/Services/{ChatServiceSid}/Users`.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceConversationWithParticipants
tags.x-displayName: Conversations v1 / Service Conversation With Participants
tags.description:
The service-scoped ConversationWithParticipants resource — create under
`/v1/Services/{ChatServiceSid}/ConversationWithParticipants`.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceParticipantConversation
tags.description:
The service-scoped ParticipantConversation read-only resource — list
under `/v1/Services/{ChatServiceSid}/ParticipantConversations`.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceUserConversation
tags.description:
The service-scoped UserConversation read-only resource — list under
`/v1/Services/{ChatServiceSid}/Users/{UserSid}/Conversations`.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceBinding
tags.description:
The service-scoped push Binding resource — list/fetch/delete under
`/v1/Services/{ChatServiceSid}/Bindings`. Bindings are system-created on
push registration (no create/update).

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceConfiguration
tags.description:
The per-service Configuration singleton — fetch/update under
`/v1/Services/{ChatServiceSid}/Configuration`.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceNotification
tags.description:
The per-service push Notification configuration singleton — fetch/update
under `/v1/Services/{ChatServiceSid}/Configuration/Notifications`.

tags.name: ConversationsV1ServiceWebhookConfiguration
tags.description:
The per-service Webhook configuration singleton — fetch/update under
`/v1/Services/{ChatServiceSid}/Configuration/Webhooks`.

tags.name: AssistantsV1Assistant
tags.description:
The Assistants v1 Assistant resource — create/list/fetch/update/delete
under `/v1/Assistants`. Twilio AI-Assistants product surface; the model
field is backed per-tenant by BYO-LLM credentials.

tags.name: AssistantsV1Tool
tags.description:
The Assistants v1 Tool resource — create/list/fetch/update/delete under
`/v1/Tools`, plus attach/detach + assistant-scoped list under
`/v1/Assistants/{id}/Tools`.

tags.name: AssistantsV1Knowledge
tags.description:
The Assistants v1 Knowledge resource — create/list/fetch/update/delete
under `/v1/Knowledge`, its read-only Status + Chunks sub-resources, plus
attach/detach + assistant-scoped list under `/v1/Assistants/{id}/Knowledge`.

tags.name: AssistantsV1Session
tags.description:
The Assistants v1 Session, Message, and SendMessage surface — list/fetch
Sessions under `/v1/Sessions`, list a Session's Messages, and send a
message to an Assistant via `POST /v1/Assistants/{id}/Messages` (creates
the Session + records the turn).

tags.name: AssistantsV1Feedback
tags.description:
The Assistants v1 Feedback resource — list/create under
`/v1/Assistants/{id}/Feedbacks`.

tags.name: AssistantsV1Policy
tags.description:
The Assistants v1 Policy read-only resource — list under `/v1/Policies`
(filter by ToolId/KnowledgeId). Policies are materialised from the inline
`policy` field on Tool/Knowledge create.

tags.name: MonitorV1Alert
tags.description:
The Monitor v1 Alert resource — list/fetch under `/v1/Alerts`. The
monitor view over failure events: call-scoped errors and messaging
delivery failures alike, rendered in the Alert shape.

tags.name: Diagnostic
tags.description:
VoiceML extension: /health probe and /openapi.{yaml,yml,json}
self-publish endpoints. Not part of Twilio's surface; tagged
separately so SDK codegen can choose to skip these or emit them
under a non-Twilio module.

tags.name: PricingV1Voice
tags.description:
The Pricing v1 Voice resource — Countries list/fetch and Numbers
fetch under `/v1/Voice`. VoiceML
bills a flat rate per account (not a per-destination ratedeck), so
Countries has exactly one entry (the tenant's own, NANP-only).

tags.name: PricingV1Messaging
tags.description:
The Pricing v1 Messaging resource — Countries list/fetch under
`/v1/Messaging`. SMS pricing only; Twilio's real schema has no
distinct MMS field.

tags.name: PricingV1PhoneNumber
tags.description:
The Pricing v1 PhoneNumbers resource — Countries list/fetch under
`/v1/PhoneNumbers`. DID monthly rental pricing.

tags.name: PricingV2Voice
tags.description:
The Pricing v2 Voice resource — Countries list/fetch and Numbers
fetch under `/v2/Voice`.

tags.name: PricingV2Trunking
tags.description:
The Pricing v2 Trunking resource — Countries list/fetch and
Numbers fetch under `/v2/Trunking`. VoiceML bills trunking
identically to voice.

basicAuth.description:
Username is the VoiceML AccountSid. When the URL contains an
account identifier, it must match this username. Password is
the per-account VoiceML API key. Twilio-issued credentials are
not accepted.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Optional replay key for POST requests. After a completed request
returns a 2xx, 3xx, or 4xx response, a subsequent request with
the same key and identical body bytes can replay that response
for up to 24 hours. Reusing a cached key with a different body
returns 409 (error code 20040). Use a distinct key for each
logical operation: keys are scoped to the account, not the URL.
Replay state is local to the serving instance and is not
persisted across restarts or shared between instances.
Concurrent requests are not reserved or coalesced, so this
header alone does not guarantee safe retries or exactly-once
execution. Authentication is checked before replay; after key
rotation, the previous API key cannot retrieve a cached result.

AccountSid.name: AccountSid
AccountSid.description:
Twilio-format AccountSid: literal "AC" + 32 hex chars (34
total). Server-generated at account creation; the same value
the customer's Twilio SDK validates in its constructor.

ConferenceSid.name: ConferenceSid
ConferenceSid.description:
Twilio-compatible Conference SID — literal `CF` + 32 hex chars
(34 total). Server-generated lazily on first
`<Dial><Conference>` dispatch (or on first appearance in
a `GET /Conferences` list); cleared when the conference
ends. The v0.19.x namespaced form
(`<AccountSid>__<friendly>`) is still accepted on input
for migration safety, but the response always emits the
CF shape.

QueueSid.name: QueueSid
QueueSid.description:
Twilio-compatible Queue SID — literal "QU" + 32 hex chars (34
total). Server-generated on `POST /Queues`.

ResourceSid.name: Sid
ResourceSid.description:
Twilio generic resource identifier on fetch-by-id endpoints
(`CA`/`RE`/`AP`/`QU`/`CF`/`PN` + 32 hex, or dashed `CA`
form). Parameter name is always `Sid`; the
path segment position determines which prefix is valid.

SubresourceSid.name: Sid
SubresourceSid.description:
Twilio-compatible subresource SID — used by Streams (`MZ` prefix),
Siprec (`SR` prefix), and Transcriptions (`GT` prefix). The
regex covers all three subresources mounted under
`/Calls/{CallSid}/{Streams|Siprec|Transcriptions}/{Sid}`.

SipDomainSid.name: Sid
SipDomainSid.description:
Twilio-compatible SIP Domain SID — literal "SD" + 32 hex chars
(34 total). Server-generated on `POST /SIP/Domains`.

SipCredentialListSid.name: Sid
SipCredentialListSid.description:
Twilio-compatible SIP CredentialList SID — literal "CL" + 32 hex
chars (34 total). Server-generated on `POST /SIP/CredentialLists`.
Also names the parent list in the Credentials sub-resource path.

SipCredentialSid.name: Sid
SipCredentialSid.description:
Twilio-compatible SIP Credential SID — literal "CR" + 32 hex
chars (34 total). Server-generated on
`POST /SIP/CredentialLists/{CredentialListSid}/Credentials`.

SipIpAccessControlListSid.name: Sid
SipIpAccessControlListSid.description:
Twilio-compatible SIP IpAccessControlList SID — literal "AL" +
32 hex chars (34 total). Server-generated on
`POST /SIP/IpAccessControlLists`. Also names the parent list in
the IpAddresses sub-resource path.

SipIpAddressSid.name: Sid
SipIpAddressSid.description:
Twilio-compatible SIP IpAddress SID — literal "IP" + 32 hex
chars (34 total). Server-generated on
`POST /SIP/IpAccessControlLists/{IpAccessControlListSid}/IpAddresses`.

SipMappingListSid.name: Sid
SipMappingListSid.description:
The mapped list's SID on a SIP Domain mapping leaf. A
CredentialList mapping carries a `CL…` sid; an
IpAccessControlList mapping carries an `AL…` sid. The mapping's
own `sid` IS the mapped list's sid (Twilio semantics).

SipParentDomainSid.name: DomainSid
SipParentDomainSid.description:
Twilio-compatible SIP Domain SID — literal "SD" + 32 hex chars
(34 total). Names the parent Domain in a Domain mapping
sub-resource path. Matches Twilio's `DomainSid` path-parameter
name for the nested mapping surfaces.

SipParentCredentialListSid.name: CredentialListSid
SipParentCredentialListSid.description:
Twilio-compatible SIP CredentialList SID — literal "CL" + 32 hex
chars (34 total). Names the parent CredentialList in the
Credentials sub-resource path. Matches Twilio's
`CredentialListSid` path-parameter name.

SipParentIpAccessControlListSid.name: IpAccessControlListSid
SipParentIpAccessControlListSid.description:
Twilio-compatible SIP IpAccessControlList SID — literal "AL" +
32 hex chars (34 total). Names the parent IpAccessControlList in
the IpAddresses sub-resource path. Matches Twilio's
`IpAccessControlListSid` path-parameter name.

PageToken.name: PageToken
PageToken.description: The page token. This is provided by the API.

to_formatted.description: Human-readable national formatting of `to`, e.g. `(415) 555-0100` for US/CA numbers. Generated via libphonenumber; falls back to the E.164 form if parsing fails.

from_formatted.description: Human-readable national formatting of `from`. Same generation rules as `to_formatted`.

parent_call_sid.description: Set on B-leg child calls (e.g. legs created by `<Dial>`). Empty on the originating A-leg or when no `<Dial>`-style bridge has occurred.

caller_name.description: SIP From: display-name captured on inbound calls (CNAM-style identification). Empty for outbound originates and for inbound calls without a display name.

forwarded_from.description: Originator of a forwarded inbound call, captured from the SIP `Diversion` (RFC 5806) or `History-Info` (RFC 7044) header. Empty for non-forwarded calls.

answered_by.description:
AMD verdict. Clients should tolerate additional verdicts
introduced in future releases.

duration.description: Seconds, as decimal string. Not currently populated on the Call resource — always empty.

price.description: The call's price, set when it ends, as Twilio renders it: a completed call the account's per-minute carrier rate times the billed time (rounded up to the billing increment), negated, to five decimals (e.g. `-0.01400`); a failed call `0.00000`; null while in progress, for a busy / no-answer / canceled call, and when no rate is available.

price_unit.description: Always `USD`, from create on, as on Twilio.

queue_time.description: Twilio compatibility — always empty on the Call resource; queue wait time is exposed on the Participant resource (`Participant.queue_time`), not here.

status.description:
`init` matches Twilio's transient pre-mix-engine state. VoiceML
never emits it today (the conference materializes only after a
participant joins), but the value is documented for SDK
enum-deserializer compatibility.

region.description:
Twilio edge region label. Defaults to `us1`; reserved
for operator-overridable region taxonomy in a future
release. Informational — VoiceML does not route
by region today.

date_created.description: Emitted via omitempty when not tracked (room state is queried live; creation timestamps are not persisted).

reason_conference_ended.description:
Populated only on the synthesised post-end response —
e.g. `conference-ended-via-api` after a
`Status=completed` POST. Empty while in-progress.

call_sid_ending_conference.description: Populated only when a participant left with `endConferenceOnExit=true`; empty otherwise.

member_count.description: VoiceML extension — count of current participants. Always present; emitted as `0` on the synthesised end-conference response.

call_sid_to_coach.description:
When `coaching` is true, the CallSid of the participant this
coach can speak to (Twilio whisper-coach). Empty when
`coaching` is false or the coach target has not joined.

coaching.description:
True when this participant joined with the `coach` role
(Twilio whisper-coach pattern). A coach hears the entire
conference but is only audible to the participant
identified by `call_sid_to_coach`.

queue_time.description:
Pre-join queue-wait in seconds, string-encoded per
Twilio's wire shape. "0" when the participant did not
transit a queue (the common case). Populated from
`<Enqueue>` dequeue events.

start_conference_on_enter.description: The per-participant `<Dial><Conference startConferenceOnEnter>` value captured at join time; falls back to the Twilio default (`true`) for participants with no recorded join.

end_conference_on_exit.description: The per-participant `<Dial><Conference endConferenceOnExit>` value captured at join time; falls back to the Twilio default (`false`) for participants with no recorded join.

status.description:
Derived from live conference state: `connected`
while the participant is in the room, `on-hold` while
the `hold` flag is set, `completed` after they've
left (visible only briefly via the synthesised
response when a mute/hold update races a leave).
VoiceML currently emits only `queued`, `connected`, and
`on-hold`; the other values are declared for SDK enum
compatibility.

label.description: Optional tag set via `<Conference participantLabel=…>`. Empty when not set.

date_created.description: Emitted via omitempty when not tracked.

date_updated.description: Emitted via omitempty when not tracked.

max_size.description: Capacity ceiling; 0 means unlimited (Twilio default). Further enqueues fail when current_size equals a positive max_size.

average_wait_time.description: Seconds in the trailing 5-minute window. 0 when no recent exits.

voice_url.description: TwiML URL fetched when <Dial><Application>SID</Application></Dial> dispatches. No web server needed — host your VoiceML documents free on voiceml.org's CDN.

voice_fallback_url.description: Fetched when voice_url returns non-2xx or fails.

message_status_callback.description: DLR (delivery-receipt) URL fired per-message for outbound SMS sent via this Application. Default DLR target when an outbound message carries no explicit StatusCallback.

sms_status_callback.description: Legacy alias of message_status_callback (DLR URL for outbound SMS). Default DLR target after message_status_callback.

sms_url.description: Twilio-compatible: webhook for inbound messages to a number whose sms_application_sid binds this Application; wins over the number's own sms_* fields.

sms_method.description: HTTP method for sms_url; Twilio's default POST when unset.

sms_fallback_url.description: Twilio-compatible: tried once, with the original parameters, when the sms_url fetch fails.

sms_fallback_method.description: HTTP method for sms_fallback_url; Twilio's default POST when unset.

VoiceUrl.description: Default voice webhook URL for the account. No web server needed — host your VoiceML documents free on voiceml.org's CDN.

AwsRegion.description: AWS region for the recording bucket.

AwsPrefix.description: Key prefix within the recording bucket.

AwsAccessKeyId.description: AWS access key ID for recording storage.

AwsSecretAccessKey.description: AWS secret access key for recording storage.

AwsKmsKeyId.description: AWS KMS key ID for server-side encryption.

AllowCidr.description:
IP allow-list, one CIDR prefix per entry (repeatable form param).
An empty list explicitly clears the allow-list (wide-open).

domain_name.description: Fully-qualified SIP domain. Required on create.

auth_type.description: Always empty in this implementation. Reserved for Twilio compatibility; no code path populates it (attaching CredentialList/IpAccessControlList mappings does not set it).

voice_region.description: Inbound Processing Region that handles inbound calls for this SIP domain.
Inbound Processing Region that handles inbound calls for this phone number.

friendly_name.description: Human-readable label (Twilio free-text semantics). VoiceML extension: when this value is a valid phone number, it is also used as the outbound caller ID presented by every device registered under this credential list; a non-numeric label sets no caller ID.

cidr_prefix_length.description: CIDR prefix length. Defaults to 32 (single host) when omitted on create.

domain_sid.description: The SipDomain resource this mapping is attached to.

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 form.

from.description: Source phone number; falls back to the tenant's configured default sender if omitted.

body.description: Message text. Empty string after a redaction update.

status.description: Production currently emits only `queued`, `sent`, and `failed`; the rest are declared for SDK enum compatibility.

num_segments.description: Per-message segment count as Twilio surfaces it — string-typed wire format.

num_media.description: Count of media items attached to the message, string-typed per Twilio. '0' for SMS-only messages.

direction.description: Production emits only `outbound-api`; other values are reserved for inbound/reply ingestion not yet implemented.

error_code.description: Twilio-compatible error codes. 21609 = gateway not configured; 30001 = upstream gateway failure.

error_message.description: Sanitised — never contains upstream URL or credentials.

parent_sid.description: The Message SID this media item is attached to (SM/MM).

content_type.description: MIME type of the media (image/jpeg, image/png, …). Null when unknown at send time.

uri.description: URI of this Media resource, relative to the API host.

as_of.description: The records are current as of this timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00, GMT).

category.description: The usage category. VoiceML reports exactly this set — the categories its product surface can accrue — each listed in every window even when zero, as the upstream API does.

count.description: Number of usage events (calls/messages). Null on the totalprice record.

end_date.description: Last day of the record's window (inclusive), GMT.

price.description: Total price over the window as a minimal-decimal string ("0.0525"), exactly as the live upstream API renders it (its OAS declares `number`; the wire is a string).

start_date.description: First day of the record's window, GMT.

uri.description: This record's list URI, carrying the resolved window.

usage.description: Usage amount in usage_unit (minutes for calls, segments for the direction splits, messages for the sms/mms aggregates; the price string on totalprice).

conference_sid.description: Set only on conference-room captures (`<Dial><Conference record="record-from-start">`); empty on per-leg recordings.

status.description:
Twilio-compatible enum. `failed` is intentionally absent — Twilio
does not document it on Recording.status (failure of an Outbound
recording surfaces as `absent`). VoiceML production code only
emits `completed`; the wider set is documented for SDK compatibility.

duration.description: Seconds; null in the response that starts a call recording.

track.description: The recorded track (`both`). Present only in the response that starts a call recording.

encryption_details.description: Reserved for SSE-KMS metadata when encryption details are exposed; currently empty.

media_url.description:
Twilio-compatible URL for the recording audio.
VoiceML serves the WAV at `/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Recordings/{Sid}.wav`
— emitted here so strict-binding SDK clients (e.g.
twilio-csharp's `recording.MediaUrl`) bind cleanly without
null-deref. Same auth requirements as the resource itself.

error_code.description:
Twilio-compatible per-call error code for failed
recordings. `null` (the common case) means no error;
non-zero values reference the error dictionary at
www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors.
The wire shape uses `null`, never `0` — strict-mode SDK
deserialisers expect null on the no-error path.

RecordingList.description:
Canonical Twilio pagination envelope for recording-list
endpoints. Used by both the account-scoped `/Recordings`
list, the per-call `/Calls/{Sid}/Recordings` list, and the
per-conference `/Conferences/{Sid}/Recordings` list — every
SDK auto-paginator depends on the same fields.

IncomingPhoneNumber.description:
Tenant-self-serve view of an assigned DID. Twilio-compatible —
`sid` is the canonical `PN`-prefixed opaque identifier (34 chars)
and `phone_number` carries the E.164 form. These are distinct
fields.

The full Twilio field set is documented here so strict-binding
SDKs deserialize without throwing. Fields VoiceML doesn't track
(regulatory, SMS, emergency, trunking) emit a Twilio-compat
default — empty string, `null`, or the documented enum default.
Customer code that reads e.g. `number.capabilities.voice`
therefore works with the same SDK patterns on VoiceML and Twilio.

friendly_name.description: Display name. VoiceML does not model a per-DID friendly name — always emitted empty and not settable via create or update.

uri.description: Path under `/2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/IncomingPhoneNumbers/{Sid}.json` — uses the canonical PN sid form.

origin.description: Fixed compatibility value: always `twilio`. Does not indicate the number's origin or provenance on VoiceML.

beta.description: Twilio-compatible: `true` for numbers from beta-availability inventory. VoiceML always emits `false`.

capabilities.description: Twilio-compatible: which channel types this DID supports. VoiceML is voice-only — `voice=true`, the rest `false`.

voice_application_sid.description: Twilio-compatible: linked `AP…` Application sid that supplies voice_url. VoiceML's `<Dial><Application>` flow keeps the link on the Application resource, not here — emits empty.

voice_caller_id_lookup.description: Twilio-compatible: CNAM lookup flag. VoiceML doesn't perform CNAM — always `false`.

voice_receive_mode.description: Twilio-compatible: VoiceML routes inbound as voice only — always `voice`.

sms_url.description: Twilio-compatible: SMS handler URL for inbound messages to this number; empty when unset.

sms_method.description: HTTP method for `sms_url`; `POST` (Twilio's default) when unset.

sms_fallback_url.description: Twilio-compatible: called when requesting or executing the TwiML at `sms_url` fails; empty when unset.

sms_fallback_method.description: HTTP method for `sms_fallback_url`; `POST` (Twilio's default) when unset.

sms_application_sid.description: Twilio-compatible: linked `AP…` Application sid that supplies the SMS webhook config; when set, the application's `sms_*` fields win over this number's own.

status_callback.description: Twilio-compatible: lifecycle webhook. VoiceML emits empty (status is per-call via Call status_callback).

trunk_sid.description: Twilio-compatible: SIP trunk routing. VoiceML uses gateway-config-driven trunking — emits empty.

address_sid.description: Twilio-compatible: regulatory street-address resource. Not tracked by VoiceML — empty.

address_requirements.description: Twilio-compatible: address requirement class. VoiceML emits `none`.

identity_sid.description: Twilio-compatible: business-identity resource. Not tracked — empty.

bundle_sid.description: Twilio-compatible: regulatory bundle. Not tracked — empty.

emergency_status.description: Fixed compatibility value: always `Active`. Does not reflect VoiceML E911 provisioning — VoiceML does not track emergency status for numbers.

emergency_address_sid.description: Fixed compatibility value: always empty. Does not reflect VoiceML E911 provisioning — VoiceML does not track an emergency address.

emergency_address_status.description: Fixed compatibility value: always `unregistered`. Does not reflect VoiceML E911 provisioning.

type.description: Number class inferred from the E.164 number: US toll-free NPAs (800/833/844/855/866/877/888) → `toll-free`; every other number → `local`. `mobile` is never inferred and the empty string is never emitted.

name.description: Operator-supplied label for the stream; round-trips on the resource.

CallPayment.description:
<Pay> REST companion resource. Twilio's response shape
is intentionally minimal — runtime config (chargeAmount,
paymentConnector, validCardTypes, etc.) is captured server-side
but not echoed back. `status` is tracked server-side for
lifecycle management but is intentionally not echoed — VoiceML
matches Twilio's minimal Payment response shape.

CallTranscription.description:
Live per-call transcription resource (REST equivalent of
`<Start><Transcription>`). Distinct from any post-recording
transcription resource — events are streamed via the
StatusCallback URL while the call is live.

Notification.description:
Twilio-compatible alert-log entry. Rows are emitted when
the TwiML document fetch or parse fails; error_code/more_info
follow Twilio's own error dictionary (11200 HTTP retrieval
failure, 12100 document parse failure). uri is call-scoped
when fetched via the /Calls/{CallSid}/Notifications route and
account-scoped via /Notifications, matching Twilio's own
fixtures. api_version, message_text, request_method and
request_url are null for a notification a verb raised with no
request of its own (the 32650/32651 transcription refusals),
as on Twilio.

log.description: Twilio renders this numeric field as a string on the wire ("0"/"1").

CallEvent.description:
Twilio-compatible per-call lifecycle event. One row per
REST request/response against a call (create + each update).
List-only — there is no fetch-by-id operation.

Transcription.description:
Async / post-recording transcription resource. Rows are created
as a side effect of `<Record transcribe="true">` and are read +
delete only. `transcription_text` is JSON `null` until `status`
reaches `completed`.

duration.description: Recording duration in whole seconds (string, per Twilio).

MonitorV1Alert.description:
The Monitor v1 Alert resource: a failure event (call-scoped
error or messaging delivery failure) rendered in the Alert
shape. The list omits the request/response detail; fetch
includes it when the row carries any.

error_code.description: Numeric error code, as a string (e.g. `11200`).

resource_sid.description: The affected resource: the message sid for messaging failures, the call sid for call-scoped ones; `null` when neither exists.

service_sid.description: Set only for message-linked rows; `null` otherwise.

request_headers.description: Fetch only: raw request headers when stored.

request_variables.description: Fetch only: request variables when stored.

response_body.description: Fetch only: response body when stored.

response_headers.description: Fetch only: response headers when stored.

MessageFeedback.description:
Delivery-quality feedback echoed back on a Message. VoiceML
records the outcome on the response only; there is no separate
downstream analytics surface.

AccountWithKey.description:
VoiceML extension: the account configuration view plus the
freshly generated `api_key`. No read endpoint returns the key.
Optional configuration fields are omitted when unset.

api_key.description: The new API key returned by rotation. Store it now. Requests using the previous key fail with 401 from this point on.

code.description: Numeric API error code (e.g. 21211); 20040 identifies an Idempotency-Key body conflict.

more_info.description: URL to Twilio's error dictionary entry: `https://www.twilio.com/docs/errors/{code}`, as live Twilio sends. Always populated.

detail.description: Human-readable error from the underlying check, including the value-vs-threshold context where relevant.

Url.description:
HTTP(S) endpoint that returns TwiML when the call answers.
Mutually exclusive with `Twiml` (inline body wins if both set).

Method.description: HTTP method used to fetch `Url` (Twilio default = POST).

Twiml.description:
Inline TwiML body — alternative to `Url`. If both are set,
`Twiml` wins (matches Twilio's documented precedence).

ApplicationSid.description:
References a stored Application resource. Its `VoiceUrl` /
`VoiceMethod` / `VoiceFallbackUrl` / `VoiceFallbackMethod` /
`StatusCallback{,Method,Event}` fields fill any per-call
request field that's empty. Per-call values always win —
the Application provides defaults, not overrides.
Cross-tenant Application lookups return 404 with the same
shape as a nonexistent sid.

FallbackUrl.description:
URL to fetch TwiML from if the primary `Url` / `Twiml`
source fails to fetch or parse. Tried only on primary
failure.

RecordingStatusCallbackEvent.description: Recording lifecycle events to report. Repeated keys carry one value each; a single space-separated value is also accepted. Default `completed`.

RecordingChannels.description: Recording channel layout: `dual` records the call's two parties into separate channels (channel 1 what the call receives from its remote party, channel 2 the call's own audio). Default `mono`.

RecordingTrack.description: `inbound` records only the audio the call receives, `outbound` only the audio it sends — always one channel; `both` (default) records both.

Trim.description: Trims leading and trailing silence from the `Record=true` recording; `trim-silence` is the default.

SendDigits.description: DTMF burst played after answer — charset `0-9*#wW` (`w`=500ms, `W`=1s pause). Wired into the originate.

CallerId.description: Twilio compatibility — accepted but ignored. VoiceML always uses `From` as the caller ID on the originating leg; `CallerId` does not override it.

CallReason.description: Stored as a custom channel variable on the originating call leg, accessible to customer dialplans for reporting and routing decisions.

SipAuthUsername.description: SIP digest auth username for BYOC trunks; channel var `sip_auth_username`.

SipAuthPassword.description: SIP digest auth password (paired with SipAuthUsername).

Byoc.description: Twilio BYOC Trunk SID. Accepted-and-ignored — VoiceML routes via gateways configured at deploy time.

AsyncAmd.description: Twilio compatibility — AMD on VoiceML is always async; this flag is accepted but redundant.

CallToken.description: Twilio CallToken for verified-caller-id flows. Accepted-and-ignored.

UpdateCallRequest.description:
POST /Calls/{Sid} body. The endpoint serves four intents:

* `Status=completed|canceled` — terminate the live call.
* `Twiml=<inline>` — execute inline TwiML on the live call;
  wins over `Url` when both are present (matches Twilio).
* `Url=…` (`Method`/`FallbackUrl`/`FallbackMethod`) — fetch
  TwiML and execute on the live call. Falls through to
  `FallbackUrl` on primary fetch/parse failure.
* `StatusCallback*` — swap the live call's lifecycle-
  callback wiring (URL / method / event-mask). Twilio
  "only-set fields" precedence: empty fields preserve the
  previous value; absent `StatusCallbackEvent` leaves the
  existing event mask, present (one or more) replaces.

Precedence: Status wins over any TwiML source. The
StatusCallback* update is independent and applies on every
request that carries it (including the terminate path).

StatusCallback.description: Swaps the live call's StatusCallback URL.

StatusCallbackMethod.description: Swaps the live call's StatusCallback HTTP method.

StatusCallbackEvent.description: Replaces the event-mask. Repeatable form param; empty list defaults to `[completed]` (Twilio default).

VoiceV1Meta.description:
Standard list `meta` envelope for /v1 lists. VoiceML serves a
single page: `next_page_url` and
`previous_page_url` are always `null`. `PageSize` is accepted
for compatibility and echoed in `page_size`, but does not limit
the response on most collections. Alerts are an exception:
their single page is limited by `PageSize` and has no continuation.

advanced_opt_out.description: VoiceML extension: when on, the inbound webhook carries OptOutType=START|STOP|HELP for keyword matches. Twilio exposes this toggle in the Console only, not on the REST resource.

ServicesSharedResponse.description:
Either a Conversation Service (IS sids, conversations host) or a
Messaging Service (MG sids, messaging host) — disambiguated by
the product host the request was sent to and, on the wire, by
the sid prefix. The host dispatch rule is documented on the
`/v1/Services` operations.

MessagingServicePhoneNumber.description:
One phone number in a Messaging Service's sender pool (Twilio's
/v1/Services/{ServiceSid}/PhoneNumbers subresource).

Unauthorized.description:
Authentication failed. All of the following return the same 401
with the same body, intentionally indistinguishable from outside:
  * Unknown :AccountSid
  * Disabled account
  * Wrong api_key
  * Source IP not in the account's allow_cidr (per-tenant allowlist)

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

BadRequest.description: Request validation failed (invalid phone number, malformed body, ...).

IdempotencyConflict.description:
Conflict: the Idempotency-Key header was already used with a
different request body (error code 20040). Send a new key with
the new body.

InternalServerError.description:
Unexpected internal error (Twilio code 20500). Emitted when a
backing store or subsystem operation fails. The body is the
standard Error envelope with a sanitized constant message.

get.description:
Paginated list of call records for the given account. Filters
match Twilio: `To`, `From`, `Status`, `ParentCallSid`,
`StartTime` (bare = full UTC day), `StartTime<` (strict upper),
`StartTime>` (strict lower), and the same triple for `EndTime`.
For backwards compatibility the legacy `StartTime>=` / `EndTime<=`
SQL-style operators are also accepted at the handler. Pagination
via `Page` and `PageSize` (max 1000). `EndTime` filters
restrict the result set to terminal-status rows (an in-progress
call has no end time and cannot match an EndTime window).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: Calls started on this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: StartTime<
parameters.description: Calls started strictly before this UTC date/time.

parameters.name: StartTime>
parameters.description: Calls started strictly after this UTC date/time.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: Calls ended on this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: EndTime<
parameters.description: Calls ended strictly before this UTC date/time.

parameters.name: EndTime>
parameters.description: Calls ended strictly after this UTC date/time.

post.description:
Originates an outbound call. The `To` and `From`
numbers are validated and normalised to E.164 against the
authenticated tenant's `phone_regions` list — set per-account in
the admin API. Empty list disables validation; multi-region
tenants accept numbers valid in any listed region.
`MachineDetection` is optional; omitting it skips AMD entirely.

post.summary: Update or terminate a live call
post.description:
Three flows on the same endpoint:
  * `Status=completed|canceled` — terminate the call.
  * `Twiml=<inline>` — execute inline TwiML on the live call
    (wins over `Url` when both are present).
  * `Url=…` — fetch new TwiML and execute it on the live call
    (live redirect / hot swap).
If `Status` is present alongside any TwiML source, `Status`
wins. The success response is the full Call resource — same
shape `GET` returns — so SDK deserialisers round-trip.

get.summary: List active conferences for the account
get.description:
Returns conferences currently active for this tenant. Live
query — no caching, always reflects state at request time.
Conferences appear once a first participant joins (typically
via TwiML `<Dial><Conference>`) and disappear as soon as the
last participant leaves.

parameters.name: FriendlyName
parameters.description: Filter to conferences with this exact FriendlyName.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Filter to conferences in this lifecycle state. VoiceML conferences are only ever `in-progress` (rooms vanish when the last participant leaves), so filtering by `init` or `completed` returns an empty list.

parameters.name: DateCreated
parameters.description: Twilio-compatible parameter. VoiceML's conference list is a live query with no historical store — accepted but does not narrow the result set.

parameters.name: DateCreated<
parameters.description: Twilio-compatible date filter — accept-but-no-op on live conference list.

parameters.name: DateCreated>
parameters.description: Twilio-compatible date filter — accept-but-no-op on live conference list.

parameters.name: DateUpdated
parameters.description: Twilio-compatible date filter — accept-but-no-op on live conference list.

parameters.name: DateUpdated<
parameters.description: Twilio-compatible date filter — accept-but-no-op on live conference list.

parameters.name: DateUpdated>
parameters.description: Twilio-compatible date filter — accept-but-no-op on live conference list.

post.description:
v1 supports only `Status=completed` — kicks every participant
and tears down the room. Twilio's other update fields
(`Announce*`) are not yet implemented.

503.description: Conference subsystem not configured (passive AMD-on-fork mode).

parameters.name: Muted
parameters.description: Filter to participants with this Muted state.

parameters.name: Hold
parameters.description: Filter to participants with this Hold state.

parameters.description: Filter to participants with this Coaching state.

post.summary: Dial a participant into a conference
post.description:
Places an outbound call from `From` to `To` that joins the named
conference on answer via inline TwiML. Returns immediately with
`status=queued` while the leg is ringing.

From.description: Caller ID / originating endpoint (E.164 or Twilio client:/sip:/app: form).

To.description: Destination endpoint to dial into the conference.

StatusCallbackEvent.description: Lifecycle events to report. Repeated keys carry one value each; a single space-separated value is also accepted. Default `completed`.

503.description: Conference or outbound dial subsystem not configured.

post.description:
At least one of `Muted` or `Hold` must be set. Twilio's
`HoldUrl` (custom hold-music URL) and `AnnounceUrl` are
not yet implemented.

delete.summary: Kick a participant out of the conference

Create a named queue. Idempotent — POSTing the same
FriendlyName a second time returns the existing queue rather
than erroring (matches Twilio).

get.summary: List queues for the account (paged, newest first)

delete.description:
Refused with 409 if any members are still waiting — caller must
drain the queue first (matches Twilio's behaviour).

get.summary: List waiting members in a queue
get.description:
Returned ordered by position; position 1 = longest waiting
(front of queue).

post.summary: Dequeue the front member to a TwiML URL
post.description:
Pops the longest-waiting member and redirects their call to the
URL in the body. The member's <Enqueue> wait-loop fetches that
URL and runs the returned TwiML on their leg as continuation.

get.summary: Fetch a specific member by CallSid

post.summary: Dequeue a specific member to a TwiML URL

Persistent named TwiML+callback bundle — referenced by
`<Dial><Application>AP…</Application></Dial>`. The agent's
Dial verb resolves the SID, fetches voice_url, and runs the
returned TwiML on the call leg.

StatusCallbackEvent.description: Application-level default event mask for calls created without their own. Repeated keys carry one value each; a single space- or comma-separated value is also accepted.

MessageStatusCallback.description: DLR (delivery-receipt) URL for outbound SMS sent via this Application.

get.summary: List Applications for the account (paged, newest first)

parameters.description: Filter to Applications with this exact FriendlyName.

StatusCallbackEvent.description: Replaces the event mask. Repeated keys carry one value each; a single space- or comma-separated value is also accepted.

Begins outbound caller-ID verification for `PhoneNumber`. Returns a
`ValidationRequest` carrying the `validation_code` the caller must
confirm. The verified number then appears as an OutgoingCallerId.

Registers a SIP Domain — the SIP-ingress surface that routes
inbound INVITEs to TwiML via `voice_url`. `DomainName` is
required.

VoiceML extension: every AOR registered under the account's SIP
Domains, with its contacts and, when the endpoint is on a call, the

API surface.

Create a SIP Credential under a CredentialList

post.summary: Create a Conversation Service or a Messaging Service
post.description:
Shared path (see ServicesSharedResponse): the same method+path
serves two different resources depending on the product host.
Send the request to the conversations host
(`conversations.` subdomain of the API base domain, e.g.
conversations.voicetel.com) to create a Conversation Service, or
to the messaging host (`messaging.` subdomain, e.g.
messaging.voicetel.com) to create a Messaging Service. Dispatch
rule: the server lowercases the HTTP Host value and checks
whether it contains `messaging` anywhere, including a port if
present. A match selects Messaging Service; otherwise —
including conversations.voicetel.com and voiceml.voicetel.com —
it selects Conversation Service. This is a substring check,
not exact hostname matching. The response sid prefix
(IS vs MG) identifies which resource was returned.
